chapter: Georgie Auld, Hawkins and Los Angeles
title: Auld's band stranded in St. Louis
summary: At the Tune Town Ballroom the band is not paid and breaks up; he goes to Chicago.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Anyway, you were with the band when it got stranded in St. Louis, right?
I don't understand how he got stranded when he had all the money. He got paid for the week, but we didn't get paid.

We were at the Tune Town Ballroom in St. Louis. And all of a sudden, the manager come up and said, "Well, fellows, we don't get paid tonight." And I said "What?" I had paid all my expenses for the week and everything, and I'm figuring "Now, what the hell am I going to do?" being that I... No money come in. So I called my little girl in Chicago and she said, "Come on through here. Where you going?" I said, "Well, I guess I'm heading back to New York." So she said, "Well, come on out here to Chicago." So I went to Chicago, and I stayed for about a week or two.
How long after you joined Georgie did this happen?
Oh, not quite a year. I thought I had me a good gig. Because we were doin' good. I mean, we did half of Lena Horne's tour with Georgie's band, and Lena and I
got along good together, so I figured I had it made. And I looked up, and the next two weeks I ain't got a gig! Oh boy, what a poop that is! Ha-hah...
